tools.name: open_life_insurance_quote_form
tools.description: Displays PuntoSeguro's life-insurance quote form, in which the user types an exact date of birth and chooses a coverage amount; submitting it shows the quotes available through PuntoSeguro. Optionally preselects a coverage amount. Sends and stores no personal data. Residents of Spain only.
